title.line: Notarial payment-order applications from two Excel exports, on Windows, a phone and Android

frames.title: Two exports in, cases out
frames.text: The case list and the invoice list are joined on load: 240 fictional cases and 1,377 invoices, checked at once.

frames.title: Problems surface on their own
frames.text: Five cases need a look: invoices that do not add up, a case without invoices, a customer code used twice.

frames.title: Companies are recognised
frames.text: A tax number in the ЕМБГ column marks a company, so it gets the standard template, never „ЕМБГ“ before a tax number.

frames.title: The document, before it exists
frames.text: The preview fills the Word template in place, keeps its formatting and marks every value that came from the data.

frames.title: Fix it without touching Excel
frames.text: A correction is kept in the app and flagged in the table and the report. The source file stays as it was.

frames.title: Rules choose the cases
frames.text: A minimum debt of 6,000 ден. and „skip cases without invoices“ select 222 of the 240.

frames.title: See where the debt is
frames.text: Debt by place, by size and by month. A click on a place filters the table.

frames.title: Generate and print
frames.text: {selected} Word files, one combined document for printing and an Excel report, in {seconds} seconds.

frames.title: Ctrl+K, light or dark
frames.text: Find a case by number, name or invoice, or run any command. The theme follows the system or your choice.

frames.title: The same engine on a phone
frames.text: The mobile app works offline and its documents are byte-identical to the desktop's. On Android the ZIP goes to the share sheet.

facts: 240 of 240 documents identical on desktop and mobile
48 of 48 mobile checks · 16 of 16 Android checks
end.note: Built with AI assistance · All data is fictional
